_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the 7 Days to Die eggs in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs and https://github.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd (MIT).
name: 7 Days to Die
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The open-world zombie survival game of crafting and base defence. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with a console through its telnet port.
startup: rm -f output_log.txt; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.; ./7DaysToDieServer.x86_64 -configfile=serverconfig.custom.xml -quit -batchmode -nographics -dedicated -logfile output_log.txt -ServerName="{{SERVER_NAME}}" -ServerPassword="{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" -ServerPort={{SERVER_PORT}} -ServerMaxPlayerCount={{MAX_PLAYERS}} -GameWorld="{{GAME_WORLD}}" -GameName="{{GAME_NAME}}" -GameDifficulty={{GAME_DIFFICULTY}} -ServerDisabledNetworkProtocols={{SERVER_DISABLED_NETWORK_PROTOCOLS}} -WebDashboardEnabled=false -TelnetEnabled=true -TelnetPort={{TELNET_PORT}} -TelnetPassword="{{PASSWORD}}" & pid=$!; tail -n +1 -F output_log.txt --pid=$pid 2>/dev/null & while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do if read -r -t 2 line; then rcon -t telnet -a 127.0.0.1:{{TELNET_PORT}} -p "{{PASSWORD}}" "$line" || echo "The game's console isn't up yet. Try again in a moment."; elif [ $? -le 128 ]; then sleep 2; fi; done; wait $pid

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# 7 Days to Die. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 294420) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Worlds and
# serverconfig.custom.xml are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-294420}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The game's serverconfig.xml is replaced by every update, so the server
# reads a copy of it that updates leave alone.
if [ ! -f serverconfig.custom.xml ] && [ -f serverconfig.xml ]; then
    cp serverconfig.xml serverconfig.custom.xml
    echo "Made serverconfig.custom.xml, the settings file the server reads."
fi
echo "Installed 7 Days to Die build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: World
variables.description: Navezgane, the hand-made map, RWG for a random one, or the name of a generated world.

variables.name: Game name
variables.description: The save's name; with RWG it is also the seed of the random world.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: From 0, the easiest, to 5, the hardest.

variables.name: Telnet password
variables.description: The password of the game's telnet console, which the server's console uses.

variables.name: Telnet port
variables.description: The port of the game's telnet console. The console reaches it inside the server, so it needs no allocation.

variables.name: Disabled network protocols
variables.description: Network protocols the server doesn't offer, comma separated: LiteNetLib, SteamNetworking.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
